title: CoCrystal PR
description: 本资源包为minecraft修改了滚动背景，闪烁标题，部分游戏贴图等。This resource pack changes Minecraft's panoramic background, splash texts, and certain game textures.
body:
# 紫铜合金美化资源包_中文 (CoCrystal_PR)

一个致力于提升 Minecraft 界面视觉体验的美化资源包，以独特的紫铜合金为主题风格。

## 当前功能

- **滚动全景背景**：替换主菜单背景为自定义全景图
- **闪烁标语**：添加了多种语言的欢迎与主题标语

## 未来计划

- 替换主菜单 Minecraft 徽标为紫铜合金风格
- 美化按钮、进度条等界面元素
- 更多惊喜…

**让紫铜合金的光泽，点亮你的 Minecraft 主菜单。**

# CoCrystal Beautification Resource Pack_English (CoCrystal_PR)

A resource pack dedicated to enhancing Minecraft's visual interface experience, featuring a unique purple copper alloy theme.

## Current Features

- **Scrolling Panorama Background** – Replaces the main menu background with a custom panoramic image
- **Splash Texts** – Added welcome and themed messages in multiple languages

## Future Plans

- Replace the main menu Minecraft logo with a purple copper alloy style
- Beautify UI elements such as buttons and progress bars
- More surprises coming…

**Let the luster of purple copper alloy light up your Minecraft main menu.**
